episode.episode: 7-15-26 - Hour 4 - If BYU defeats Notre Dame and Utah will they go 12-0 this season?
episode.showDescription: Cougar Sports with Ben Criddle (@criddlebenjamin) keeps you up-to-date on all things BYU Sports. We not only cover football & basketball, but we dive into recruiting, baseball, soccer, and more. For insight that you can't get anywhere else, tune into 103.9/ 98.3 FM. Monday-Friday from 2-6 PM MST. Follow us on social media @espnthefan & interact with us using #ESPNTheFan.
episode.episodeDescription: Ben Criddle talks BYU sports every weekday from 2 to 6 pm. Today's Host: Ben Criddle (@criddlebenjamin) and Co-Host: (ronthe3manweav) Subscribe to the Cougar Sports with Ben Criddle podcast: Apple Podcasts: https://itunes.apple.com/us/podcast/cougar-sports-with-ben-criddle/id99676

transcript_window.text: You had to go to Manhattan, Kansas.
That was a tough road game, 41 -28.
But then Iowa State, three -point loss.
The BYU game was an anomaly, I think.
Finishing off the beating Houston.
That Houston team was good.
Yeah, on the road.
Really good.
Houston Cougars, that's a good football team, a good football program.
You beat Cincinnati too, and it wasn't really close.
That's the TCU team.
And then you beat USC, who had a really good season in a bowl game at the Alamo Bowl in OT.
That's the TCU team of last year.
So if it can be built from that foundation, with that momentum, I think another nine win, possibly ten win or even better season could be at the helm.
Well, what we've especially in these past five years.

The Big 12, we stopped doing the preseason polls because we were kind of exposing ourselves by every team that we picked to win finished last and every team we finished to pick last was We just have no idea how good these teams can be.
And what we know is the conference is going to be deep.
This slate of coaches, I mean, these head coaches are exceptional.
And so you give anybody time to prepare and pay attention to the matchups and see something maybe that they can exploit.
And all bets are off.
And that's probably not a good pun to use.
But, you know, it's really exciting.
It's it's exciting to know you better come prepared every weekend.
And to your point, we finish the season on really high notes with three really quality wins.
And that's what you want heading into the offseason is that kind of momentum.
